_comment: Copy to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/copilot-proxy/config.json (default ~/.config/copilot-proxy/config.json). Every key is optional; environment variables and .env override this file.
_domain_note: Set this to a GitHub Enterprise host to use that tenant instead, e.g. your-tenant.ghe.com. The OAuth, token-exchange and API URLs are all derived from it.
_bind_note: Loopback by default. Use 0.0.0.0 only if a container must reach it; the proxy has no authentication of its own.
_dump_dir_note: Optional. Set dump_dir to write every upstream request body to disk for debugging. It contains your prompt content in the clear, so leave it unset unless you are actively debugging.
